name: Fascinate (Su)
category: Drop Dead Studios – Advanced Rogue Talents
body:
Prerequisites: Major Artistic Talent, Advanced Rogue Talents.

Benefit: A rogue with this talent gains the ability to use the Perform skill to cause one or more creatures to become fascinated with her. This acts as the fascinate bardic perform ability, except the save DC is 10 + 1/2 the rogue’s level + her Charisma bonus, and it lasts 1 round/level. The rogue may use this ability once per day plus once for every 5 rogue levels she possesses.
